name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
description: A national registration scheme creating a unified database of unorganised sector workers (including gig and platform workers), issuing each worker a lifelong 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) as a single doorway to social security benefits and welfare scheme access.
benefits: Free 12-digit lifelong UAN identity card valid across India; automatic accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh (death/total disability) and Rs. 1 lakh (partial disability) under PM Suraksha Bima Yojana linkage; acts as the gateway database for direct benefit transfer during emergencies (cyclone/flood/heat-wave relief) and access to multiple welfare schemes.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen working in the unorganised sector, aged 16 to 59 years
Must not be a member of EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation) or ESIC (Employees' State Insurance Corporation)
Must not be an income tax payer
Gig and platform workers (delivery, ride-hailing, etc.) are eligible if not covered by EPFO/ESIC
how_to_apply: Visit eshram.gov.in, click 'Register on e-Shram', verify via Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP, fill in personal, address, and occupation details, and submit. Registration is completely free. If Aadhaar is not linked to a mobile number, registration can be completed at a Common Service Centre (CSC) using biometric authentication.
